traits.name: Charge
traits.text:
If the embolotherium moves at least 20 feet straight toward a
target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes
an extra 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must
succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text:
The embolotherium deals double damage to objects and
structures.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 28
(4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
